name: ihost_open_sound
comment: Original name ihost_open_sound (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body (0x28-byte stream slots from id 10000, iRes_FOPEN, 0x20-byte name, use count); the only unpaired caller of iRes_FOPEN on both sides); was FUN_10007a90.

name: AudioLib_ParseWaveFileHeader
comment: Drives Im_VimaDecodeBlock over a compressed sound chunk Original name AudioLib_ParseWaveFileHeader (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body start (an MCMP header is skipped, RIFF / 'WAVEfmt ' checked, *param_2 = 0 first); callers CacheGetSoundId, the dispatcher's region change and the sound start agree; not a VIMA decoder); was Im_VimaDecompress.

name: AudioLib_DetectRawFormat
comment: Compressed (VIMA-style ADPCM) block decoder using the step/index tables; identity inferred from structure Original name AudioLib_DetectRawFormat (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): AudioLib_ParseWaveFileHeader's only callee; same byte-delta statistics over the 8-bit samples); was Im_VimaDecodeBlock.
